summary: Fixed in 60633eff3 (#710). The prefetch and the watcher's first-page load now go through fetchFirstBranchesPage, which joins any in-flight first-page promise for the same environmentId/cwd/query key. A thread open (the prefetch effect runs, then the useGitBranches watcher effect in the same commit) now sends one vcs.listRefs. The poller runs input.run in a microtask after creation, so the watcher always joins the pending prefetch RPC. A recreated watcher also adopts a list fetched within the 15 s stale time (runImmediately: !adoptCached), so ChatView remounts no longer refetch. Nothing in the web client duplicates this on thread open: every other listRefs caller is a dialog or a one-off search with a different payload. The 'same pattern for status prefetches' part of the proposal does not apply. Git status is a refcounted stream keyed per cwd/view/interval, there is no status prefetch, and refreshStatus already has a keyed in-flight map. I looked for regressions in the fix and found none.

evidence.note: branchesFirstPageInFlight replaces the removed prefetch-only branchesPrefetchInFlight Set (deleted in 60633eff3).
fetchFirstBranchesPage returns the pending promise or registers a new one. A read detached by invalidation or reset reports fetchedAt null.
loadInitialBranchesNow (watcher first load via pollBranches) goes through the shared fetch.

prefetchBranchesByKey bails if a first page is in flight or a controller exists. Otherwise it uses the shared fetch and discards its own publish when a controller appeared meanwhile (the controller publishes the same result).
refresh() calls run via Promise.resolve().then(run): a microtask after watchBranches. The prefetch RPC is still pending then, so the watcher joins it.
A recreated watcher adopts a fresh cached list and skips the immediate run.
This is the only prefetchBranches caller. The prefetch effect is declared before useGitBranches (useGit.ts:60 useEffect), and both use the same key: query '' with the initial deferred query ''.
The test asserts one listRefs for prefetch plus watcher of the same key. It runs in the node environment without window, so it covers the no-poller path, but the poller path only adds a microtask.
Status is a refcounted stream subscription and refreshStatus has a keyed in-flight map. There is no status prefetch, so the proposal's status remark does not apply.

fixDefects: None that regress or reintroduce the duplicate. Minor notes, not defects: (1) Joiners now share a failure: if the shared first-page read fails, the watcher shows the error until the next 60 s poll or a lifecycle/focus refresh. Before, it made its own attempt, which would normally have failed the same way. (2) An invalidation during the initial load drops the shared in-flight entry, but the poller's own inFlight dedupe (visibilityPolling.ts:47) still swallows the controller's refresh, so the pre-change list can stay up to 60 s. This predates the fix (the old code behaved the same way) and only matters if a branch mutation runs during the first load. (3) The dedupe unit test does not exercise the browser poller path.
decisionReason: Client-only caching change already merged. It does not touch auth, E2EE, hosted lifecycle or the Hub.
